Title: Predefined notification - edit and restore
Preconditions: Admin signed in at {{BACK_URL}} with notification management permissions; notification type 'InvoiceEmailNotification' ships a predefined template, so its Templates grid carries a predefined-badged row for that language; if that row is already badged 'Edited', restore it first so the case starts from the un-edited baseline; module version is the PR #202 build or later. The predefined and edited flags are synthesized in the templates-list and blade controllers for display only, so assert them in the UI and never against the API
Steps:
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/#!/workspace/notifications
[WAIT] Notifications list blade loaded
[GRID] search the list for 'InvoiceEmailNotification'
[ACT] click the row matching 'InvoiceEmailNotification'
[WAIT] the '...: Details' blade opens with the Templates grid
[GRID] note the badges on the predefined template row
[ACT] click the predefined template row
[WAIT] the '...: Template' blade opens
[ACT] append a distinct marker to 'Subject'
[SAVE] click 'Save' in the blade toolbar
[WAIT] the save settles and the Templates grid refreshes
[ACT] click the same template row again
[WAIT] the '...: Template' blade reopens
[ACT] click 'Restore' in the blade toolbar
[WAIT] the restore settles
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] the save issues PUT /api/notifications/{type} and returns 2xx (VCST-5607: the drill-down path issues no PUT today)
[API] GET /api/notifications/InvoiceEmailNotification returns the override content after the save and the shipped default content after the restore
[CONSOLE] no JS errors during the edit, the save or the restore
Failure_Signals: No warning note while the predefined-sourced template is edited; Restore missing from the toolbar after an override was saved; appended marker still present after Restore; Edited badge retained after Restore; no PUT issued on Save
Cleanup: Restore the template to its shipped default and confirm through the API that no override marker remains
References: C255756 C255757 VCST-5557 VCST-5606 - editability of a predefined template is documented override behaviour (PlatformUserGuide, Notification Templates), not a defect; Synced: VCST-5557 / PR #202 (2026-07-29)

Title: Send edited predefined template
Preconditions: state from NOTIF-046 (an override of the shipped default exists for that language, so the Templates grid row is badged both 'Predefined' and 'Edited', and the '...: Template' blade is open on it); outbound mail transport configured for the environment
Steps:
[ACT] click 'Send test email' in the blade toolbar
[WAIT] the recipient prompt is shown
[ACT] fill 'Email': {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}
[ACT] click 'Send'
[WAIT] a notification about the send result appears
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] the send request returns 2xx with no 4xx/5xx
[EMAIL] exactly one message arrives at {{ADMIN_EMAIL}} within 60s
[CONSOLE] no JS errors during the send
Failure_Signals: 'Send test email' disabled on a predefined-sourced template; shipped default content delivered instead of the override; 4xx/5xx on send; no message within 60s
Cleanup: Close the Template and Details blades without saving, leaving the override exactly as NOTIF-046 left it

Title: Notification Attachment — No Attachment
Preconditions:
Admin logged in to Backend
Notification template exists without attachments
Steps:
1. Navigate to ${BACK_URL}/notifications
2. Select a notification type that has no attachments configured
3. Open the notification template details blade
4. Verify the Attachments widget or section is visible
5. Verify the attachment list is empty
6. Verify the UI indicates the no-attachment state clearly (e.g., empty state message)
7. Send a test notification from this template
8. Verify the received email has no file attachments
